158-159AD. Roman. Probable Antoninus Pius (138-161AD) sestertius. Length 30.2mm, Width 28.5mm, Thickness 4.4mm, Diameter 30.2mm, Weight 14.5g. Obverse: Laureate and draped bust right. Inscription: (AN)[](TRP)XXII. Reverse: Possible octastyle temple of Divus Augustus with 'SC' either side. Inscription: (CO.SIII - in the exergue). Mint name: Rome. Die axis: 210 deg. or 7 o'clock. Worn with broken down and corroded edges. However, there is an attractive pale brown patina but also 30% surface corrosion with some green verdigris. Ref.
